author: Etai Zilberman
name: BitNet b1.58: 12x768 MLP3x Ternary + Chinchilla Scaling
blurb: 64.5M ternary-weight transformer (12 layers, 768 dim, MLP 3x) packed at 1.6 bits/param via base-3 encoding. Trains with STE ternary quantization and fp16 scales for zero roundtrip gap. Chinchilla-optimal: 3.8x more params than baseline in same artifact size.
